in_sanskrit.name: समर्थ
in_sanskrit.meaning: Strong, Capable, Brave, Vigorous, Valiant, Fearless
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: समर्थः (samarthaḥ) - सम: sama (with) + र्थ: rtha (need, want, ability) Having the ability, strength, or resources to accomplish something; capable, strong, brave, vigorous, valiant, fearless.

in_hindi.name: समर्थ
in_hindi.long_meaning: सामर्थ्य (sāmarthya) - साम: saama (with) + र्थ: rtha (need, want, ability) Having the ability, strength, or resources to accomplish something; capable, strong, brave, vigorous, valiant, fearless.

in_tamil.name: சமர்த்த
in_tamil.long_meaning: ஸமர்த்தம் (samartham) - ஸம: sama (with) + ஃர்த்தம் (rtham) (need, want, ability) Having the ability, strength, or resources to accomplish something; capable, strong, brave, vigorous, valiant, fearless.

in_telugu.name: శమర్థ్
in_telugu.long_meaning: శమర్థ్యము (samarthyamu) - శమ: shama (with) + ర్థ్ (rtha) (need, want, ability) Having the ability, strength, or resources to accomplish something; capable, strong, brave, vigorous, valiant, fearless.

in_marathi.name: Samarth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Samarth हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who has great knowledge, wisdom, and is skilled in various areas

vedic_reference.note: The name Samarth is derived from the Sanskrit language and is used in Hinduism. It is a compound word, samar + tha, which means 'having the ability'. The name is found in various Hindu texts, including the Vedas, and is believed to have been used as a name for deities and great sages.
